verify.summary: Fresh independent T2 verification passed both half-open boundaries, exact baseline inclusion/exclusion classes, 9/2/5/2 open and 9/2/7/0 closed reconciliation, exact ratios and nullable/completed verdicts, reject/duplicate/non-serving exclusions, empty zero/null output, SELECT-only ownership and cleanup. A verifier-owned serving-switch branch failed: one Photo admitted and searchable under revision A disappeared after current serving changed to B (expected population/success 1/1 and true; observed 0/0 and null) because the projection filters by current rather than admission-time serving revision. Executor evidence remained supporting-only.

Fresh independent T2 verification passed both interval boundaries, canonical 9/2/5/2 open and 9/2/7/0 closed results, exact ratios and nullable/completed verdicts, empty zero/null output, reject/duplicate exclusion, SELECT-only ownership, cleanup and the prior A-to-B serving-switch regression at 1/1/0/0. The required explicit non-serving revision-state branch failed: adding revision B state to one Photo admitted under A changed the expected 9/2/5/2 and ratio 2/9 to 10/3/5/2 and 0.3 because production counts state rows rather than each accepted Photo once. Executor evidence remained supporting-only.

Fresh independent T2 verification on the exact packaged image passed the canonical 9/2/5/2 open and 9/2/7/0 closed matrix, exact ratios and nullable/completed verdicts, both half-open boundaries, empty zero/null output, every required state class and reject/duplicate exclusions. Both historical defects are resolved: A remains 1/1 after current serving A-to-B, and after a complete B state is added the two persisted rows still project exactly one A admission result. Six production calls were one SELECT each in read-only transactions with unchanged owner snapshots; isolated cleanup left zero database/container/network/volume residue. Attempts 1/2 remain historical FAILs, Attempt 3 remains a non-counting pre-edit stop, and executor evidence remained supporting-only.

evidence_required: FT-002-AC-004 RED: no controlled projection reconciles the full accepted-JPEG population and nullable 95% verdict through the persisted admission-revision state; GREEN: the required fixture applies the half-open interval, classifies early ready, late ready, no_faces, failed, aged pending/processing and young open rows exactly once, preserves an A-admitted Photo after current serving switches to B, ignores its additional B state, and returns all-zero counts with null ratio/verdict for an empty population; decisive comparison: population equals success+breach+open, every Photo has one admission-state row, boundary membership is exact, non-empty ratio is exact and verdict stays null until open=0 then follows >=0.95; artifact: controlled-clock SLO table and SELECT-only query output.
purpose: Compute the accepted controlled-interval ingest-to-searchable result from each Photo's durable admission-revision state without hiding late or terminal non-searchable Photos.
success_outcome: Every independently accepted Photo in the interval joins exactly one immutable admission-revision state and reconciles once to success, breach or open; later revision rows never replace or duplicate it, explicit exclusions stay outside, and the 95% verdict appears only for a closed population.
anti_goals: Do not add a metrics store, materialized counters, batch readiness, rolling scheduler, lineage registry/history or new product capacity target.
Do not exclude no_faces, failed, delayed Calibration work or late pending/processing Photos.

forbidden_scope: Realtime reference-query execution and participant result assembly owned by FT-004
Calibration calculation, recommendation and run persistence owned by FT-011
Photo delete, restore and hard-purge behavior owned by FT-012
stop_conditions: The required immutable admission-revision pair is not available from its completed prerequisite.
A truthful verdict would require a new product definition or monitoring subsystem.

constraints: Use a controlled clock and the half-open [accepted_from, accepted_before) interval.
Join each Photo only to its immutable admission_pipeline_revision_id state and use persisted accepted_at/searchable_at facts.
Keep rejects and duplicates as explicit test exclusions; a later non-serving revision state is ignored without excluding or duplicating its admitted Photo.
invariants: Success requires searchable strictly before 15 minutes.
One accepted Photo contributes exactly one SLO classification through its immutable admission revision, regardless of later serving switches or revision rows.
Late ready, no_faces, failed and aged pending/processing are breaches.
meets_95_percent is null while open is nonzero.
An empty population has zero counts and null success_ratio/meets_95_percent.
verification_targets: Controlled population records both half-open boundaries, every inclusion/exclusion, three counts, ratio and nullable/completed 95% verdict, plus the exact all-zero/null empty result.
